Maya (CSM): Heads-up — AtlasCo (mid-market) signaled they want to downgrade from Growth -> Starter at renewal. Renewal in 29 days. Usage down 38% WoW, activation stalled.
Maya (CSM): Quick metrics snapshot: ```Active endpoints: 5 -> 3
Avg tokens/day: 14k -> 8.6k
Streaming calls: 7k -> 1.8k
Top route p95 latency: 220ms
Open support tickets: 3 (onboarding, rate-limit confusion)```
Jonah (CS Ops): Link to 90d trend: <https://redwood.local/dashboard/accounts/ATLAS-009/usage|usage dashboard> — looks like they disabled streaming on 3 routes last week.
Jonah (CS Ops): Is this price-driven or do they think product quality is the problem?
Alex (AE): Spoke w/ their eng lead yesterday — CFO called it out as a cost problem and devs say responses regressed on one model, so they turned off streaming and embeddings to save $$ (noted frustration).
Maya (CSM): They also rolled back to lower-rate API keys. We should avoid reactive downgrade w/o trying re-engagement.
Priya (Enablement): I can run a 30-min enablement office hour + config audit. Focus: batching, prefix/KV cache, tuned quant/profiles, and prompt templates to cut tokens.
Priya (Enablement): Checklist I'll hit: 1) confirm active routes + keys 2) review batching settings (batch_window, max_batch_size) 3) demo prefix cache/KV cache usage 4) quick prompt edit to reduce hallucination/retries
Maya (CSM): Proposed short save plan: 
- Day 0: Outreach + schedule workshop (owner: Maya)
- Day 2: 30-min enablement + live config audit (Priya)
- Day 3: Jonah applies 2-week $5k credits and temporary config patch for increased batching/prefix cache
- Day 7: Measurement check (usage + success metrics)
- Day 14: Exec check w/ Alex; if adoption < +15% propose phased downgrade with usage guardrails
Jonah (CS Ops): I can provision the credits and push a one-off config patch to enable prefix cache and bump max_batch_size to 64 for targeted routes. Need finance sign-off (cc @Alex).
Alex (AE): I approve up to $5k credits for a rapid save. I'll take an exec call with the CFO and ask for a commitment to try the enablement. Maya, can you draft a one-paragraph ROI?
Maya (CSM): Draft for CFO: "Enablement + prefix caching and batching expected to reduce per-token cost by ~30% and restore streaming. Projected net monthly savings ~ $3.2k; short pilot credit $5k to validate — expected payback inside 1 renewal cycle."
Alex (AE): Nice, send that to me and I'll include in the CFO email.
CS Bot: Sent onboarding nudge to AtlasCo dev lead at 5891234580 — auto-reminder scheduled for workshop invite.
Priya (Enablement): I'll prep a 1-pager + a short demo script (15 min demo, 10 min Q&A). Also create a small checklist they can run post-workshop.
Maya (CSM): Assignments: Maya (owner - outreach + follow-ups), Priya (deliver enablement), Jonah (credits + config patch), Alex (exec outreach).
Jonah (CS Ops): On it. I'll also add a temporary rate-limit guard to prevent accidental overages while they re-enable streaming.
Maya (CSM): Goal: avoid downgrade. Target metric: +25% active tokens/routes within 14 days after workshop. If we see adoption w/ improved token economics, we escalate to retention win. :white_check_mark:
Alex (AE): I'll call the CFO today. Ping me the draft when ready. :eyes:
Maya (CSM): Will post workshop invite + agenda by EOD. Quick ack if you're on this plan.
Priya (Enablement): ack
Jonah (CS Ops): ack
Alex (AE): ack
Maya (CSM): Thanks team — will update thread after workshop and share before/after metrics.
